thread:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock DP recruitment slate + acceptance & cancellation paths before Thu planning. Goal: 12 partners with a mix across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Thoughts?

Liam (ProdOps): Timeline looks ok from ops side. My proposal: 6 hosted, 4 dedicated, 2 private to cover infra variance.

Sabrina (Design): Acceptance criteria idea: active engineering contact, willingness to run 1x weekly demo/checkin, signed NDA or PO, and a product use-case that exercises latency/cost tradeoffs. Prefer teams shipping to customers (not just R&D).

Chen (Eng): Engineering constraints to call out — we need a named eng point-of-contact for each partner during integration windows. Also require ability to run our smoke suite within 14 days of onboarding.

Arjun (Solutions): Incentives: $3k credits + 90m onboarding workshop + prioritized issue triage for the pilot window. For private customers include 2 dedicated onboarding sprints.

Nora (Research): Feedback cadence suggestion: weekly async form (short) + biweekly 45m interviews for first 6 weeks, then monthly check-ins. Use the same eval prompt set across partners for comparability.

Maya (PM): Screening questions (short list to put in outreach):
```
1) Current inference provider and model(s)?
2) Expected peak QPS / typical request size?
3) Compliance/regulatory needs (SOC2/HIPAA/etc)?
4) Target rollout timeline (alpha/beta/GA)?
5) Primary success metric (latency / cost / qualitative accuracy)?
```

Liam (ProdOps): Gating rules: accept if they meet >=2 eng contributors, can run smoke tests in <=14 days, and sign the engagement terms. Drop or deprioritize leads with no response in 10 calendar days.

Sabrina (Design): Cancellation / offboarding path: 30-day data retention followed by deletion, a 2-step offboard checklist (shared notes, exported logs), and a soft-offer to extend pilot if integration delays are the cause.

Chen (Eng): Add to gating: partner must provide a minimal test dataset and an expected inference profile (seq length, typical prompts). For private deployments, request a runbook for key management.

Maya (PM): Quick acceptance rubric (short):
- Tech readiness (smoke test pass window)
- Engagement (weekly checkins + demo slot committed)
- Clear measurable metric & timeline

Nora (Research): For evaluation: we should publish the eval prompt set + scoring weights and run a simple leaderboard per cohort. That will help spot regressions across model variants.

Arjun (Solutions): Ops note: reserve 1 dedicated infra node per private partner for the first 2 weeks of integration. Also schedule two 90m onboarding slots per week for partners.

Maya (PM): Action items (owners + due dates):
- Liam: finalize outreach template + screening form (due Wed EOD)
- Sabrina: update acceptance/cancellation doc & push PR to dp-playbook (due Thu morning)
- Chen: produce smoke-test checklist + sample script (due Thu)
- Nora: prepare eval prompts & scoring + leader board template (due Thu)

Liam (ProdOps): Will draft outreach and screening form, pinging legal for NDA snippet. I’ll share by EOD Wed.

Sabrina (Design): I’ll update the doc and link the PR here once ready.

Chen (Eng): I’ll drop the smoke script in the repo. Sample quick-check CLI:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-lambda-7b","input":"smoke test"}'
```

Maya (PM): We also need to decide refund/cancellation policy: propose 50% refund if partner cancels before integration begins; 0% after integration started. Thoughts?

Arjun (Solutions): Sounds reasonable to me — keeps commitment signal.

deploy-bot: Reminder: sprint planning meeting Thu 10:00 added to #calendar.

Maya (PM): Thanks team :tada: I’ll consolidate these notes into the DP one-pager and share for final sign-off before planning.
